# Cities Development Initiative For Asia (CDIA)

> CDIA is an ADB-administered multi-donor trust fund providing project preparation support and technical assistance for climate-resilient infrastructure development in Asia-Pacific secondary cities.

CDIA works with secondary cities across Asia to develop sustainable urban infrastructure projects, particularly in water sanitation, climate adaptation, and resilient city planning. The initiative connects cities with expert consultants, funding mechanisms, and capacity-building resources to advance infrastructure investment and urban development.

- [Services and Key Areas](https://cdia.asia/services-and-key-areas): Overview of CDIA's services including project preparation and infrastructure development support.
